properties.name: Health and Counseling Center
properties.use: Medical care and mental-health counseling for students: appointments, short-term therapy, referrals, health education.

properties.name: Naito Hall
properties.use: Residence hall on the north side of campus near the sports fields.

properties.name: Sullivan Hall
properties.use: Residence hall on the north side of campus near the sports fields.

properties.name: Eliot Hall
properties.use: Reed's original 1912 academic building: humanities and social science classrooms and faculty offices, the admission office and the chapel.

properties.name: Old Dorm Block
properties.use: Reed's original 1912 Tudor Gothic dormitory, divided into eight halls (Abington, Doyle, Eastport, Kerr, Ladd, Quincy, Westport, Winch).

properties.name: Student Union
properties.use: Large hall for dances, concerts, student events and Renn Fayre; houses Paradox Café, a coffee shop.

properties.name: Student Center
properties.use: Student activities office and multicultural resource center: club support, event planning and identity-based community programs.

properties.name: Gray Campus Center
properties.use: Commons dining hall, bookstore, mail services and SEEDS (community service and engagement office).

properties.name: Kaul Auditorium
properties.use: Main auditorium for concerts, lectures, convocation and large events; includes Gray Lounge for receptions.

properties.name: Physical Plant
properties.use: Facilities Services: maintenance, grounds, custodial and trades shops that keep the campus running.

properties.name: Eric V. Hauser Memorial Library
properties.use: Eric V. Hauser Memorial Library: stacks, study spaces, special collections and archives, thesis tower; also the Cooley Art Gallery for exhibitions.

properties.name: Vollum College Center
properties.use: Lecture hall (used for large lectures such as the Humanities 110 lectures), faculty offices and a lounge.

properties.name: Eliot Circle
properties.use: Traffic circle and lawn at the main entrance in front of Eliot Hall; a common meeting and drop-off point.

properties.name: Greywood Hall
properties.use: Alumni and parent relations, campus information and career services (Center for Life Beyond Reed).

properties.name: Educational Technology Center
properties.use: Instructional technology support, computer labs and media services for classes and faculty.

properties.name: MacNaughton Hall
properties.use: Coed residence hall named for a former Reed president.

properties.name: Foster Hall
properties.use: Coed residence hall with divided doubles; the other half of the original Foster-Scholz.

properties.name: Anna Mann Hall
properties.use: Historic 1920 residence hall by A.E. Doyle, originally for women and now coed (about 32 residents).

properties.name: Scholz Hall
properties.use: Coed residence hall built 1954–55; originally half of the Foster-Scholz men's dorm.

properties.name: Psychology
properties.use: Psychology department labs, classrooms, faculty offices and an auditorium.

properties.name: McKinley Hall
properties.use: Cross Canyon residence hall, mostly first-years (about 28 residents).

properties.name: Chittick
properties.use: Cross Canyon residence hall, mostly first-years (about 28 residents).

properties.name: Woodbridge Hall
properties.use: Cross Canyon residence hall, mostly first-years (about 28 residents).

properties.name: Griffin Hall
properties.use: Cross Canyon residence hall, named for an early faculty member; mostly first-year students (about 28 residents).

properties.name: Bragdon Hall
properties.use: Newest Cross Canyon residence hall (1998), named for a former Reed president; mostly first-years.

properties.name: Reed College Apartments
properties.use: Furnished apartments available to students after their first year.

properties.name: Reed College Apartments
properties.use: Furnished apartments available to students after their first year.

properties.name: Reed College Apartments
properties.use: Furnished apartments available to students after their first year.

properties.name: Reed College Apartments
properties.use: Furnished apartments available to students after their first year.

properties.name: 28 West
properties.use: Offices for Community Safety (campus security, escorts, emergency response) and Residence Life (housing assignments, house advisors).

properties.name: Sitka House
properties.use: Grove residence hall (2008) with house-style living.

properties.name: Sequoia House
properties.use: One of the four Grove residence halls (completed 2008), with house-like suites and shared kitchens and common rooms.

properties.name: Aspen House
properties.use: Grove residence hall (2008); also contains a multipurpose classroom and Caffè Paradiso, a café.

properties.name: Bidwell House
properties.use: Grove residence hall (2008) with house-style living.

properties.name: Biology
properties.use: L.E. Griffin Memorial Biology Building: biology labs, classrooms and an auditorium.

properties.name: Chemistry
properties.use: A.A. Knowlton chemistry building: teaching and research labs, classrooms and faculty offices.

properties.name: Performing Arts Building
properties.use: Opened 2013: theatre, dance and music departments with a studio theatre, black box, rehearsal halls, scene and costume shops.
properties.changes: Built after this 2010 map; replaces functions of #13 and #17.

properties.name: Reed College Sports Center
properties.use: Gym, indoor pool, fitness rooms and courts; physical education classes, club sports and intramurals.

properties.name: Physics
properties.use: Physics department classrooms, teaching labs and research labs.

properties.name: Studio Arts
properties.use: Studio art department: painting, sculpture, printmaking and photo studios, critiques; Feldenheimer Gallery shows student and visiting work.

properties.name: Prexy Hall
properties.use: Music building on this map (a former president's residence): practice rooms, lessons and music offices.
properties.changes: Music largely moved to the Performing Arts Building in 2013.

properties.name: Parker House
properties.use: 1929 Arts and Crafts house bought by Reed in 2005; three guest rooms for visiting lecturers, academics and trustees, plus meeting rooms for retreats, faculty dinners and Gray Fund student dinners.

properties.name: Dorothy Johansen House
properties.use: Former home of alumna, history professor and archivist Dorothy Johansen; now houses academic support services (tutoring, writing and study help).

properties.name: Garden House
properties.use: Small themed house (about ten students) focused on sustainability and environmental justice; residents tend gardens and run related programming.

properties.name: Canyon House
properties.use: Residence hall that serves as an extension of the Garden House sustainability and environmental justice community.

properties.name: German House
properties.use: German language house (8 singles) with a language scholar; hosts campuswide cultural events.

properties.name: French House
properties.use: French language house with a language scholar; hosts films, meals and concerts.

properties.name: Russian House
properties.use: Small residence where students practice Russian, with a live-in native-speaker language scholar; hosts films, meals and cultural events.

properties.name: Spanish House
properties.use: Spanish language house with a language scholar; its plaza is a shared gathering space for the language houses.

properties.name: Chinese House
properties.use: Chinese language house with a language scholar; tea, cooking and cultural activities.
properties.changes: Reed has since moved the Chinese House to sit closer to the other language houses; language scholars now also include Arabic.

properties.name: Farm House
properties.use: Small house-style residence hall.

properties.name: Reed Warehouse
properties.use: Storage for theatre sets, props and costumes plus general college warehousing and receiving.
properties.changes: Most theatre production work moved to the Performing Arts Building in 2013.

properties.name: Trillium
properties.use: Reed's largest residence hall, opened 2019 near the Grove where tennis courts used to be; about 180 first-year students, LEED Platinum.

properties.name: Cerf Amphitheatre
properties.use: Outdoor amphitheatre on the canyon used for concerts, gatherings and Renn Fayre events.
